notes: Focused adapter-backed test of the preferred order specified by each interaction class in the supplied FDD. Without calling Change Interaction Order Type, a timestamped Send Interaction for a Timestamp-preferred class is sent in timestamp order and returns a retraction designator; for a Receive-preferred class it is sent in receive order and returns no retraction designator. The callbacks preserve class identity, parameter, tag, producer, time, sent order, and resolvable transportation. The test does not claim the full interaction order-classification matrix or conformance.
